import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, sqlite3
BASE='http://127.0.0.1:3000'
def req(path, method='GET', data=None, expected=200):
    raw=None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request(BASE+path,data=raw,method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as x: code=x.status; body=json.loads(x.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as x: code=x.code; body=json.loads(x.read())
    assert code==expected,(path,code,body)
    return body
w=req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan'); assert w['revision']==1
s1=req('/api/sessions','POST',{'userId':'riley','workbookId':'ops-plan'},201)
s2=req('/api/sessions','POST',{'userId':'morgan','workbookId':'ops-plan'},201)
def save(session,user,base,workbook,expected=200,extra={}):
    return req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save','POST',{'workbookId':'ops-plan','baseRevision':base,'workbook':workbook,'sessionId':session,'userId':user,**extra},expected)
# Trust boundary rejection and no revisions
bad=json.loads(json.dumps(w['workbook'])); bad['title']='Tampered'
save(s1['sessionId'],'riley',1,bad,400)
save(s1['sessionId'],'morgan',1,w['workbook'],403)
for invalid in [None,-1,1.5,'1',99]:
    payload={'workbookId':'ops-plan','baseRevision':invalid,'workbook':w['workbook'],'sessionId':s1['sessionId'],'userId':'riley'}
    req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save','POST',payload,400)
assert len(req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/revisions')['revisions'])==1
# First save
one=json.loads(json.dumps(w['workbook'])); one['sheets'][0]['cells']['F2']='draft one'
r1=save(s1['sessionId'],'riley',1,one); assert r1['revision']==2
# Different cell from same base merges
other=json.loads(json.dumps(w['workbook'])); other['sheets'][0]['cells']['G2']='draft two'
r2=save(s2['sessionId'],'morgan',1,other); assert r2['revision']==3 and r2['workbook']['sheets'][0]['cells']['F2']=='draft one'
# Same cell from stale base conflicts without revision
conf=json.loads(json.dumps(w['workbook'])); conf['sheets'][0]['cells']['F2']='losing'
save(s2['sessionId'],'morgan',1,conf,409)
assert len(req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/revisions')['revisions'])==3
# unchanged does not create revision
save(s2['sessionId'],'morgan',3,r2['workbook']); assert len(req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/revisions')['revisions'])==3
hist=req('/api/workbooks/ops-plan/history/plan/F2'); assert hist['lastChangedBy']['userId']=='riley'
print('API, validation, merge, conflict, attribution: PASS')
